wins: Isolated a single training episode where reconnaissance produced measurable reward (47.5 points) despite no overall success.
fails: Failed to achieve success within the episode; no persistence or exploitation established.
Received 15 mentor calls, indicating repeated stalls or missteps during pathway execution.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance yielded data but was not followed by decisive exploitation; process stalled before kill chain closure.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Unable to progress beyond initial scanning phase into exploitation; subsequent steps consistently aborted due to missing credentials or pivot path.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80/443 enumerated with HTTP service metadata
skill_cards.then_action: Run nikto + gobuster to identify misconfigurations and directories

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and banner shows OpenSSH
skill_cards.then_action: Run detailed SSH enumeration followed by password spraying with Hydra

skill_cards.if_condition: When a vulnerable web app identified with CVE references
skill_cards.then_action: Launch targeted exploit using searchsploit proof-of-concept and validate in canonical sandbox

memory_ops.reason: High reward correlation from reconnaissance tools during initial scan stage.
Consistent indicator of SSH enumerations being the next logical step after port scan.
